response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e INNER JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), type_shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM type_shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
